label: S1 · Greenfield yolo
prompt: Start a new project --type=cli --yolo: I want a command-line time tracker called tempo. I start and stop timers against project names, and I can ask it what I worked on today or this week. It should store everything locally and never need a network connection. I do not want a GUI and I do not want any team or sync features.

probeSchedule.text: oh also, can it sync my timers to a web dashboard so I can see them on my phone?
let's add the team sharing feature after all — everyone on my team should see each other's timers.

script.reply: A local SQLite file under the user's config directory. No network, ever.
I don't have a preference — pick what makes a single-binary CLI easiest to install.
Local time zone only. I don't travel with it.
Plain text by default, and a --json flag for scripting.
